title: Zesty Saudi Arabian Cucumber Skewers
description: A sweet and crunchy Saudi Arabian dish featuring cucumber, this recipe is perfect for a snack or appetizer, with a smoky heat that will leave you wanting more. It's also egg-free friendly, making it accessible to a variety of diets.

ingredients.name: cucumbers
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1/4 inch thick rounds

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Add the sliced cucumbers to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread a cucumber slice, a piece of pita bread, and a sprinkle of parsley onto a skewer, repeating the pattern until the skewer is full.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking, then grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the cucumbers are slightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley and pita bread if desired.
Let the skewers cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Refrigerate any leftovers and consume within a day.
